title: Deep greedy unfolding: Sorting out argsorting in greedy sparse recovery algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2505.15661v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Gradient-based learning imposes (deep) neural networks to be differentiable at all steps. This includes model-based architectures constructed by unrolling iterations of an iterative algorithm onto layers of a neural network, known as algorithm unrolling. However, greedy sparse recovery algorithms depend on the non-differentiable argsort operator, which hinders their integration into neural networks. In this paper, we address this challenge in Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (OMP) and Iterative Hard Thresholding (IHT), two popular representative algorithms in this class. We propose permutation-based variants of these algorithms and approximate permutation matrices using "soft" permutation matrices derived from softsort, a continuous relaxation of argsort. translated_title: 深度贪心展开：在贪心稀疏恢复算法中解析argsorting问题
translated_abstract: arXiv:2505.15661v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：基于梯度的学习要求（深度）神经网络在所有步骤中都是可微分的。这包括通过将迭代算法的迭代展开到神经网络层上构建的基于模型的架构，即算法展开。然而，贪心稀疏恢复算法依赖于不可微的argsort算子，这阻碍了它们集成到神经网络中。在本文中，我们针对正交匹配追踪（OMP）和迭代硬阈值（IHT）这两个该类的代表性算法解决了这一挑战。我们提出了这些算法的基于排列的变体，并使用由softsort（argsort的连续松弛）导出的“软”排列矩阵来近似排列矩阵。我们理论上和数值上证明，Soft-OMP和Soft-IHT作为OMP和IHT的可微对应物，与神经网络训练完全兼容，并且有效地工作。
tldr: 本文通过引入基于softsort的软排列矩阵，将贪心稀疏恢复算法（OMP和IHT）转化为可微分的Soft-OMP和Soft-IHT，从而使其能够无缝集成到深度神经网络训练中，并保持高效性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Soft-OMP and Soft-IHT, differentiable variants of greedy sparse recovery algorithms, by approximating the non-differentiable argsort with soft permutation matrices from softsort, enabling seamless integration into deep neural network training while maintaining efficiency.
